route._ceiling_measured: 8 Sep 2026 21:55 CEST: a 3-pass probe of this exact DSN (/root/a23probe, -mp 3 -mt 1) auto-routed in 28 min 58 s, so a 120-pass ceiling cannot be reached inside any budget and 1.9.0 writes its session only when the whole job ends: the 15:56 round burned 2 h and the 17:59 round would have burned 4 h more, both NO_SESSION. 18 passes at the measured rate lands near 2 h 50 min, inside the 5 h limit. The lesson is C8's of 17:50 restated: set the ceiling from a measured pass rate, never from an ambition.
route._jar_unpinned: 11 September 2026: this pinned ~/bin/freerouting-1.9.0.jar, the STOCK jar, which set FR_JAR and so bypassed route_one's own choice AND its refusal. Our 1.9.0 build writes a session after every pass; the stock one writes one only when the whole job ends, so a run that is cut leaves nothing, which is what every NO_SESSION round in the record is. Unpinned: route_one takes the patched jar when the host has it and refuses when it does not, unless FR_REQUIRE_MESH=0 says otherwise deliberately.
route._rail_planes_why: 15 September 2026 (red team round four C2a), A36 IS THE MEASUREMENT: the rails' locked bands and islands stay in the DSN as planes so the router sees their pads connected and lays no parallel wire.
